# The Open Apologetic - Development Context

## Technology Stack

- **Framework**: Astro 5.17.1
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Content**: Astro Content Collections
- **Styling**: CSS Modules
- **Build Tool**: Astro (Vite-based)

## Architecture Patterns

### Project Structure

```
src/
├── components/       # Reusable UI components
│   ├── foundation/   # Base components (Button, Card, Callout)
│   └── layout/       # Layout components (Header, Footer)
├── content/          # Content collections
│   └── evidence/     # Evidence articles
├── layouts/          # Page layouts
├── pages/            # Route pages
│   └── evidence/     # Evidence category pages
└── styles/           # Global styles
```

### Content Collections

The project uses Astro Content Collections with a `evidence` collection:

```typescript
// src/content/config.ts
import { defineCollection, z } from 'astro:content';

const evidence = defineCollection({
  type: 'content',
  schema: z.object({
    title: z.string(),
    description: z.string(),
    category: z.enum(['scientific', 'historical', 'catholic']),
    order: z.number(),
    icon: z.string().optional(),
    externalResources: z.array(
      z.object({
        title: z.string(),
        url: z.string().url(),
        type: z.enum(['book', 'video', 'article', 'website']).optional(),
      })
    ).optional().default([]),
  }),
});

export const collections = { evidence };
```

### Page Implementation

Pages use dynamic routing with content collection queries:

```astro
---
// src/pages/index.astro
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout/index.astro';
import Card from '../components/foundation/Card/index.astro';

const evidenceTopics = [
  {
    title: 'Fine-Tuned Universe',
    description: 'The universe exhibits extraordinary precision...',
    href: '/evidence/fine-tuned-universe',
    icon: '🌌'
  },
  // ...
];
---

<BaseLayout title="Home" currentPath="/">
  <div class={styles.grid}>
    {evidenceTopics.map((topic) => (
      <Card href={topic.href} variant="evidence" icon={topic.icon}>
        <span slot="title">{topic.title}</span>
        {topic.description}
      </Card>
    ))}
  </div>
</BaseLayout>
```

### Component Patterns

Components follow Astro patterns with TypeScript interfaces:

```astro
---
// src/components/foundation/Button/index.astro
import styles from './styles.module.css';

interface Props {
  href?: string;
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'gold';
  size?: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large';
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  disabled?: boolean;
  class?: string;
}

const { href, variant = 'primary', size = 'medium', ... } = Astro.props;

const classList = [
  styles.button,
  styles[variant],
  styles[size],
  fullWidth && styles.fullWidth,
  className
].filter(Boolean);
---

{href ? (
  <a href={href} class:list={classList}>
    <slot />
  </a>
) : (
  <button type={type} disabled={disabled} class:list={classList}>
    <slot />
  </button>
)}
```
